info.title: Unfolding People Designer
info.description: Sends a design image made in this conversation to Unfolding People and returns a link that opens it on a T-shirt or hoodie, ready to order.

post.summary: Put the design image on a T-shirt or hoodie
post.description: Call this after generating the final design image. Attach exactly that one image in openaiFileIdRefs.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Exactly one image: the final design image generated in this conversation (PNG with a transparent background preferred).

garment.description: Which garment the customer wants. Use tshirt if they did not say.

link.description: Link that opens the design studio with the design on the garment
